correctness.rationale: The identity h^n(s)=1/(n+s^(-1)) is exact. Shared uniform coupling differs only when the previous Markov state is one, giving rho Delta_1 plus sum Delta_n Pr(Z_{n-1}=1) = O(N^(-kappa)); first-coordinate marginal supplies the matching lower bound when beta0 != beta1. Reference product Bernoulli variables have sum mean log(1+beta0 N^(1-kappa))+O(N^(-kappa)); Lindeberg applies in kappa<1, Laplace functionals and Le Cam give Poisson point process/count TV at kappa=1, and Markov inequality implies vanishing visits for kappa>1. First-hit survival telescopes exactly from state zero. Independent rational path-enumeration at N=6,beta=(2/5,4/5),rho=3/10 gives TV .0226698 vs lower bound .0165441. No almost-sure limit for changing triangular experiments is claimed.
